user.title: LAN Discovery Hub
user.description: One hub per Home Assistant instance. It browses mDNS, searches SSDP and probes open TCP ports, merges every sighting into one entry per device, and tells you which integration can add it.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only a single instance is allowed.

init.title: Scan settings
init.description: Choose which channels to scan. mDNS is passive and cheap, SSDP searches once per round, and TCP probing fills in ports and MAC addresses for devices already seen.

data.full_sweep: Also probe every host in the local /24

scan.name: Scan the local network
scan.description: Run one discovery round across the enabled channels.

full.name: Full subnet sweep
full.description: Also probe every host in the local /24. This is slow.

acknowledge.name: Acknowledge device
acknowledge.description: Mark a discovered device as handled so it is left out of the notification summary.

device_id.name: Device ID
device_id.description: The device_id from the sidebar panel or the sensor attributes.
